161	//  caller-provided accessor `src(mn, kbase + k)`. Routing the source axis
162	//  through the accessor is what lets the SAME wgmma issue (TransA=0/TransB=0,

169	__device__ __forceinline__ void stage_kmajor_tile(
170	        __nv_bfloat16* smem_tile, int kbase, Src src, int t0, int nthreads) {
171	    // MN*16 elements, each thread strides.
172	    #pragma unroll 1
173	    for (int i = t0; i < MN * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK; i += nthreads) {
174	        const int mn = i / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
175	        const int k  = i % wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
176	        const int dst = (k >> 3) * (MN * 8) + mn * 8 + (k & 7);

215	        int mbase0, int m_atoms, int n_real, int k_steps,

225	    wgs::WgmmaAccum<N> acc[MaxAtomsM];
226	
227	    // For each stacked atom (M-base = mbase0 + a*64), run the full k-chain.
228	    #pragma unroll 1
229	    for (int a = 0; a < m_atoms; ++a) {
230	        const int mbase = mbase0 + a * wgs::kWgmmaAtomM;
231	        if (in_wg0) wgs::wgmma_fence();

233	        for (int k = 0; k < k_steps; ++k) {
234	            // Stage A (64x16) for THIS atom's rows [mbase, mbase+64) and B (Nx16),

236	            stage_kmajor_tile<wgs::kWgmmaAtomM>(

238	                [&] (int mn, int kk) { return srcA(mbase + mn, kk); },

241	                smemB, k * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK,
242	                [&] (int mn, int kk) { return srcB(mn, kk); },

245	            if (in_wg0) {
246	                wgs::SmemDesc dA = wgs::make_desc_A_kmajor<wgs::kWgmmaAtomM, wgs::kSwizzleNone>(smemA);

288	// (fwd) Y[M,Nout] = X[M,Kin] @ W[Nout,Kin]ᵀ.  Tiles N over [0,Nout) in width-N
289	// atoms (Nout∈{d=128, 3d=384, dff=512}). M = kTileM (kAtomsM stacked atoms).
290	// Y is written row-major [M, Nout] at base `Yout` with row stride Nout.
291	// NOTE on weights: the params blob is fp32; the wgmma engine needs bf16 B
292	// operands. We convert ON READ in the accessor (`__float2bfloat16(W[...])`) —
293	// deterministic, so every read yields the same bf16 (determinism-safe), and it
294	// needs NO bf16 weight buffer or cross-CTA conversion phase. Cost: weight bytes
295	// read as fp32 (2×) in fwd/dX — a perf-phase optimization, not a correctness gate.
296	template <int N>
297	__device__ __forceinline__ void dectc_gemm_fwd(
298	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ X, const float* __restrict__ W,
299	        __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ Yout, int Kin, int Nout,
300	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
301	    const int k_steps = Kin / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
302	    for (int n0 = 0; n0 < Nout; n0 += N) {
303	        const int n_real = (Nout - n0) < N ? (Nout - n0) : N;
304	        auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 { return X[(int64_t)m * Kin + k]; };
305	        auto srcB = [&] (int n, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
306	            int nn = n0 + n; return nn < Nout ? __float2bfloat16(W[(int64_t)nn * Kin + k]) : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
307	        auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) {
308	            Yout[(int64_t)m * Nout + n0 + n] = __float2bfloat16(v); };
309	        tc_gemm_block_unpipelined<N, /*MaxAtomsM=*/kAtomsM>(
310	            0, kAtomsM, n_real, k_steps, srcA, srcB, out, sA, sB);
311	    }
312	}

325	        auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 { return X[(int64_t)m * Kin + k]; };

328	        auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) { Yf32[(int64_t)m * Nout + n0 + n] = v; };

335	// by width N). K = Nout (the contracted out_dim). W is staged transposed:
336	// srcB(n=kin, k=out) = W[out·Kin + kin] (fp32 → bf16 on read). Writes fp32 dX
337	// [M,Kin] (LN/elementwise bwd consume it fp32).
338	template <int N>
339	__device__ __forceinline__ void dectc_gemm_dx_f32(
340	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ dY, const float* __restrict__ W,
341	        float* __restrict__ dXf32, int Kin, int Nout,
342	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
343	    const int k_steps = Nout / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
344	    for (int n0 = 0; n0 < Kin; n0 += N) {
345	        const int n_real = (Kin - n0) < N ? (Kin - n0) : N;
346	        auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 { return dY[(int64_t)m * Nout + k]; };
347	        // B[n=kin, k=out] = W[out, kin]  (transposed read; fp32 → bf16).
348	        auto srcB = [&] (int n, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
349	            int nn = n0 + n; return nn < Kin ? __float2bfloat16(W[(int64_t)k * Kin + nn]) : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
350	        auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) { dXf32[(int64_t)m * Kin + n0 + n] = v; };
351	        tc_gemm_block_unpipelined<N, /*MaxAtomsM=*/kAtomsM>(
352	            0, kAtomsM, n_real, k_steps, srcA, srcB, out, sA, sB);
353	    }

356	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
357	//  Per-CTA TILE SCRATCH (HBM). One tile's forward intermediates the backward
358	//  reads, reused across the tiles a CTA grid-strides over (a CTA finishes a
359	//  tile's fwd+bwd before the next tile, so one slab per CTA suffices). Sized
360	//  for kTileM rows. The X-inputs / dY-adjoints that OTHER CTAs read in P2's dW
361	//  do NOT live here — they live in the full-T DecActs (cross-CTA). This holds
362	//  only the within-tile fwd state + the running adjoint so the backward needs
363	//  NO recompute.
364	//
365	//  DEDICATED, NON-ALIASED buffers (the TC test sizes its own workspace; HBM is
366	//  NOT scarce, so hand-managed aliasing — the stride/alias bug class that bit
367	//  the scalar path at model_stages_decoder.cuh:619-625, which the CPU mirror
368	//  does NOT cover for tile-batched reuse — is avoided entirely). Each fp32
369	//  intermediate gets its own slot.
370	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
371	
372	// nSamp samples per tile, H*S*S attention entries each; V logits each.
373	constexpr int kNSampPerTile  = kTileM / dec::kSeq;
374	constexpr int kAttnPerTile   = kNSampPerTile * dec::kHeads * dec::kSeq * dec::kSeq;
375	constexpr int kLogitsPerTile = kNSampPerTile * dec::kVocab;
376	
377	// CRITICAL: the forward runs ALL layers, THEN the backward runs ALL layers (NOT
378	// interleaved per-layer). So every forward intermediate the backward reads PER
379	// LAYER must be stored PER LAYER — a single-buffered cache holds only the LAST
380	// layer's values and the earlier layers' backward reads garbage (the "forward
381	// exact, layer-0 grads wrong, error compounds backward" bug). qkv / ff0pre /
382	// attn / n1·n2 LN caches are therefore [kLayers]-indexed. fnx/fni (final norm,
383	// one instance) + the transient dh/x1/finalin/logits/work/work2/dsc stay single.
384	struct DecTileScratch {
385	    __nv_bfloat16* qkv[dec::kLayers];     // [kTileM, 3d]  per layer
386	    __nv_bfloat16* ff0pre[dec::kLayers];  // [kTileM, dff] per layer
387	    float* attn[dec::kLayers];            // [kAttnPerTile] per layer
388	    float* n1x[dec::kLayers]; float* n1i[dec::kLayers];
389	    float* n2x[dec::kLayers]; float* n2i[dec::kLayers];
390	    float* dsc;             // [kAttnPerTile] attention dscores (transient, bwd-only)
391	    float* fnx; float* fni; // final-norm LN caches (single)
392	    float* dh;              // [kTileM, d]    running adjoint wrt block output
393	    float* x1;              // [kTileM, d]    n1 output (fp32, residual base for r2)
394	    float* finalin;         // [kTileM, d]    last-layer n2 output (fp32, head input)
395	    float* logits;          // [kLogitsPerTile] per-sample last-pos logits (fp32)
396	    float* work;            // [kTileM, dff]  GEMM output / general fp32 scratch
397	    float* work2;           // [kTileM, dff]  second fp32 scratch (bwd dx1/dqkv)
398	};

400	// Bytes one CTA's scratch occupies (for host sizing of the workspace tail).
401	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t dec_tile_scratch_bf16_count() {
402	    // (qkv + ff0pre) per layer.
403	    return (int64_t)dec::kLayers * ((int64_t)kTileM * 3 * dec::kD + (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kDff);
404	}
405	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t dec_tile_scratch_f32_count() {
406	    return (int64_t)dec::kLayers * (                     // per-layer:
407	             (int64_t)kAttnPerTile                       //   attn
408	           + 2 * ((int64_t)kTileM * dec::kD + kTileM))    //   n1+n2 xhat+inv
409	         + (int64_t)kAttnPerTile                          // dsc (single)
410	         + ((int64_t)kTileM * dec::kD + kTileM)           // fn xhat+inv (single)
411	         + (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kD                      // dh
412	         + (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kD                      // x1
413	         + (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kD                      // finalin
414	         + (int64_t)kLogitsPerTile                        // logits
415	         + 2 * (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kDff;               // work + work2
416	}
417	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t dec_tile_scratch_total_f32() {
418	    return (dec_tile_scratch_bf16_count() + 1) / 2 + dec_tile_scratch_f32_count();
419	}

421	__device__ __forceinline__ DecTileScratch dec_tile_scratch_bind(float* slab) {
422	    DecTileScratch s;
423	    __nv_bfloat16* b = reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(slab);
424	    int64_t bo = 0;
425	    for (int li = 0; li < dec::kLayers; ++li) { s.qkv[li]    = b + bo; bo += (int64_t)kTileM * 3 * dec::kD; }
426	    for (int li = 0; li < dec::kLayers; ++li) { s.ff0pre[li] = b + bo; bo += (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kDff; }
427	    float* f = slab + (dec_tile_scratch_bf16_count() + 1) / 2;
428	    int64_t fo = 0;
429	    for (int li = 0; li < dec::kLayers; ++li) { s.attn[li] = f + fo; fo += kAttnPerTile; }
430	    for (int li = 0; li < dec::kLayers; ++li) { s.n1x[li] = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kD; s.n1i[li] = f + fo; fo += kTileM; }
431	    for (int li = 0; li < dec::kLayers; ++li) { s.n2x[li] = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kD; s.n2i[li] = f + fo; fo += kTileM; }
432	    s.dsc  = f + fo; fo += kAttnPerTile;
433	    s.fnx  = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kD;
434	    s.fni  = f + fo; fo += kTileM;
435	    s.dh   = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kD;
436	    s.x1   = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kD;
437	    s.finalin = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kD;
438	    s.logits  = f + fo; fo += kLogitsPerTile;
439	    s.work    = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kDff;
440	    s.work2   = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * dec::kDff;
441	    return s;
442	}

445	//  TILE-AWARE SCALAR ELEMENTWISE STAGES (fp32, CTA-cooperative over kTileM
446	//  rows). These mirror the scalar oracle's per-row math (model_stages_decoder
447	//  .cuh) but operate on a whole tile of `nrows` rows at once, reading/writing
448	//  HBM [rows×width] buffers. Reductions reuse the validated dec_block_sum /
449	//  dec_block_max helpers (whole-block, looped per row — LN/softmax are ≪1% of
450	//  FLOPs, so the sequential row loop is not a bottleneck). `red` is a 256-float
451	//  smem reduction slot (from the engine's smem arena).
452	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
453	
454	// LayerNorm fwd over the last dim d, for `nrows` rows. y, xhat are fp32 HBM
455	// [rows×d]; inv is fp32 HBM [rows]. gamma/beta are fp32 [d] (params). Caches
456	// xhat+inv for the bwd (identical to dec_layernorm_fwd but tiled).
457	__device__ __forceinline__ void dectc_ln_fwd_tile(
458	        const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ gamma,
459	        const float* __restrict__ beta, int nrows,
460	        float* __restrict__ y, float* __restrict__ xhat, float* __restrict__ inv,
461	        float* red) {
462	    for (int s = 0; s < nrows; ++s) {
463	        const float* xr = x + (int64_t)s * dec::kD;
464	        float sum = 0.0f;
465	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < dec::kD; j += blockDim.x) sum += xr[j];
466	        float mean = dec_block_sum(sum, red) / (float)dec::kD;
467	        float vs = 0.0f;
468	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < dec::kD; j += blockDim.x) { float c = xr[j] - mean; vs += c * c; }
469	        float var = dec_block_sum(vs, red) / (float)dec::kD;
470	        float iv = rsqrtf(var + dec::kLnEps);
471	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) inv[s] = iv;
472	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < dec::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
473	            float xh = (xr[j] - mean) * iv;
474	            xhat[(int64_t)s * dec::kD + j] = xh;
475	            y[(int64_t)s * dec::kD + j] = xh * gamma[j] + beta[j];
476	        }
477	        __syncthreads();
478	    }
479	}

481	// LayerNorm bwd for `nrows` rows: dy [rows×d] fp32, cached xhat/inv → dx [rows×d]
482	// fp32; ACCUMULATES dgamma/dbeta (summed over the tile's rows) into a per-CTA
483	// LN-vec partial slot gw/gb [d] (plain += : single owner thread per feature j
484	// across rows, deterministic — same rule as the scalar dec_layernorm_bwd).
485	__device__ __forceinline__ void dectc_ln_bwd_tile(
486	        const float* __restrict__ dy, const float* __restrict__ xhat,
487	        const float* __restrict__ inv, const float* __restrict__ gamma, int nrows,
488	        float* __restrict__ dx, float* __restrict__ gw, float* __restrict__ gb,
489	        float* red) {
490	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < dec::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
491	        float dgw = 0.0f, dgb = 0.0f;
492	        for (int s = 0; s < nrows; ++s) {
493	            float d = dy[(int64_t)s * dec::kD + j];
494	            dgb += d; dgw += d * xhat[(int64_t)s * dec::kD + j];
495	        }
496	        gw[j] += dgw; gb[j] += dgb;
497	    }
498	    for (int s = 0; s < nrows; ++s) {
499	        const float* dyr = dy + (int64_t)s * dec::kD;
500	        const float* xhr = xhat + (int64_t)s * dec::kD;
501	        float sda = 0.0f, sdax = 0.0f;
502	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < dec::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
503	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * gamma[j]; sda += dxhat; sdax += dxhat * xhr[j];
504	        }
505	        sda = dec_block_sum(sda, red);
506	        sdax = dec_block_sum(sdax, red);
507	        float iv = inv[s];
508	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < dec::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
509	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * gamma[j];
510	            dx[(int64_t)s * dec::kD + j] = iv * (dxhat - (sda + xhr[j] * sdax) / (float)dec::kD);
511	        }
512	        __syncthreads();
513	    }
514	}

516	// Per-sample causal self-attention FORWARD over a tile. qkv is bf16 HBM
517	// [rows×3d] (q|k|v). Writes ctx fp32 HBM [rows×d] and attn weights fp32 to
518	// `attn_w` [nSamp×H×S×S]. Each (sample,head,qpos) row is owned by one thread —
519	// identical math to dec_forward_sample's attention block, looped over samples.
520	__device__ __forceinline__ void dectc_attn_fwd_tile(
521	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ qkv, int nrows,
522	        float* __restrict__ ctx, float* __restrict__ attn_w) {
523	    const int nsamp = nrows / dec::kSeq;
524	    const float scale = dec::attn_scale();
525	    const int rows_per = nsamp * dec::kHeads * dec::kSeq;   // (sample,head,qpos)
526	    for (int r = threadIdx.x; r < rows_per; r += blockDim.x) {
527	        const int si = r / (dec::kHeads * dec::kSeq);
528	        const int rem = r % (dec::kHeads * dec::kSeq);
529	        const int hh = rem / dec::kSeq, qi = rem % dec::kSeq;
530	        const int qoff = hh * dec::kDhead;
531	        const int rbase = si * dec::kSeq;        // first row of this sample
532	        const __nv_bfloat16* qrow = qkv + (int64_t)(rbase + qi) * 3 * dec::kD + qoff;
533	        float maxs = -CUDART_INF_F; float sc[dec::kSeq];
534	        #pragma unroll
535	        for (int kj = 0; kj < dec::kSeq; ++kj) {
536	            if (kj > qi) { sc[kj] = -CUDART_INF_F; continue; }
537	            const __nv_bfloat16* krow = qkv + (int64_t)(rbase + kj) * 3 * dec::kD + dec::kD + qoff;
538	            float dot = 0.0f;
539	            #pragma unroll
540	            for (int t = 0; t < dec::kDhead; ++t)
541	                dot += __bfloat162float(qrow[t]) * __bfloat162float(krow[t]);
542	            sc[kj] = dot * scale; maxs = fmaxf(maxs, sc[kj]);
543	        }
544	        float denom = 0.0f;
545	        #pragma unroll
546	        for (int kj = 0; kj < dec::kSeq; ++kj) {
547	            float e = (kj <= qi) ? __expf(sc[kj] - maxs) : 0.0f; sc[kj] = e; denom += e;
548	        }
549	        float invd = 1.0f / denom;
550	        float* aw = attn_w + ((int64_t)(si * dec::kHeads + hh) * dec::kSeq + qi) * dec::kSeq;
551	        #pragma unroll
552	        for (int kj = 0; kj < dec::kSeq; ++kj) aw[kj] = sc[kj] * invd;
553	        #pragma unroll
554	        for (int t = 0; t < dec::kDhead; ++t) {
555	            float acc = 0.0f;
556	            #pragma unroll
557	            for (int kj = 0; kj <= qi; ++kj) {
558	                float vv = __bfloat162float(qkv[(int64_t)(rbase + kj) * 3 * dec::kD + 2 * dec::kD + qoff + t]);
559	                acc += aw[kj] * vv;
560	            }
561	            ctx[(int64_t)(rbase + qi) * dec::kD + qoff + t] = acc;
562	        }
563	    }
564	    __syncthreads();
565	}

570	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
571	//  FORWARD over one TOKEN TILE (nrows = nsamp samples × kSeq positions), global
572	//  token rows [g0, g0+nrows). Tile-batched: the four per-layer linears
573	//  (in_proj/out_proj/ff0/ff2) run on wgmma (M=nrows, N-tiled); attention/LN/
574	//  GELU are scalar fp32 over the tile; head/CE are scalar per-sample (M=nsamp<
575	//  64). Writes the DecActs X-inputs (bf16 dW operands), the per-CTA tile scratch
576	//  (qkv/ff0pre/attn/LN caches/x1/finalin/logits the bwd needs), and returns the
577	//  tile's summed NLL (thread 0 holds it). `tok_ids`/`tgt_ids` are HBM int32.
578	//
579	//  DATAFLOW (DecActs X-regions = bf16 dW operands AND inter-stage operands;
580	//  dedicated fp32 scratch for residuals/LN; weights convert fp32→bf16 on read):
581	//    X_in[li]  := layer input (bf16)           [embedding for li=0]
582	//    qkv(bf16) := X_in @ in_w^T
583	//    ctx       := attn(qkv) → X_ctx[li] (bf16, out_proj input + dW operand)
584	//    a(work)   := X_ctx @ out_w^T ; r1=X_in+a (work); n1(r1)→x1(fp32)→X_x1[li]
585	//    ff0(work) := X_x1 @ ff0_w^T → ff0pre(bf16); gelu→X_gact[li](bf16)
586	//    ff2(work) := X_gact @ ff2_w^T ; r2=x1+ff2 (work); n2(r2)→X_in[li+1]
587	//                 (last layer: n2→finalin fp32, the head input)
588	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
589	__device__ float dectc_forward_tile(
590	        const DecWeights& w, int g0, int nrows, const DecActs& acts,
591	        const DecTileScratch& sc, const int* __restrict__ tok_ids,
592	        const int* __restrict__ tgt_ids,
593	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB, float* red) {
594	    const int nsamp = nrows / dec::kSeq;
595	    // ── Embedding: X_in[0][r] = tok[token_id[g0+r]] + pos[(g0+r)%S]. bf16. ──
596	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * dec::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
597	        const int r = idx / dec::kD, j = idx % dec::kD;
598	        const int g = g0 + r;
599	        const int tid = tok_ids[g];
600	        const int sp = g % dec::kSeq;            // position within the sample
601	        float v = w.tok[(int64_t)tid * dec::kD + j] + w.pos[(int64_t)sp * dec::kD + j];
602	        acts.X_in[0][(int64_t)g * dec::kD + j] = __float2bfloat16(v);
603	    }
604	    __syncthreads();
605	
606	    for (int li = 0; li < dec::kLayers; ++li) {
607	        const DecWeights::Layer& L = w.layer[li];
608	        const __nv_bfloat16* Xin = acts.X_in[li] + (int64_t)g0 * dec::kD;        // [nrows,d]
609	        // qkv = Xin @ in_w^T   (N=3d, K=d). bf16 → scratch.qkv[li].
610	        dectc_gemm_fwd<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(Xin, L.in_w, sc.qkv[li], dec::kD, 3 * dec::kD, sA, sB);
611	        __syncthreads();

193	//  Canonical Major-K smem stager (LIFTED verbatim from the decoder TC twin —
194	//  the wgmma engine is model-agnostic). Writes ONE MN×16 tile in the CUTLASS
195	//  Major-K INTERLEAVE layout (wgmma.cuh):
196	//      idx(mn,k) = (k/8)*(MN*8) + mn*8 + (k%8)
197	//  pulling element (mn, k) from a caller accessor `src(mn, kbase + k)`. Routing
198	//  the source axis through the accessor lets the SAME wgmma issue (TransA=0/
199	//  TransB=0, the substrate-validated orientation) serve fwd / dX / dW.
200	//  Cooperative over `nthreads` threads starting at thread `t0`.
201	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
202	template <int MN, typename Src>
203	__device__ __forceinline__ void stage_kmajor_tile(
204	        __nv_bfloat16* smem_tile, int kbase, Src src, int t0, int nthreads) {
205	    #pragma unroll 1
206	    for (int i = t0; i < MN * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK; i += nthreads) {
207	        const int mn = i / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
208	        const int k  = i % wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
209	        const int dst = (k >> 3) * (MN * 8) + mn * 8 + (k & 7);
210	        smem_tile[dst] = src(mn, kbase + k);
211	    }
212	}

214	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
215	//  Unpipelined single-CTA batch GEMM: D[M,N] = Σ_k A[m,k]·B[n,k], bf16 operands
216	//  (accessor-sourced + Major-K staged), fp32 accumulator, ascending-k. LIFTED
217	//  verbatim from the decoder TC twin (the engine is model-agnostic; only the
218	//  MaxAtomsM bound differs at the call sites — ViT's token tile is 17 atoms).
219	//
220	//  This helper computes ONE M-block of `m_atoms` stacked m64 atoms (rows
221	//  [mbase0, mbase0 + m_atoms*64)) for ONE N-tile of the compile-time atom width
222	//  N. The CALLER loops M-atom-blocks × N-tiles to cover arbitrary (M, N).
223	//  MaxAtomsM bounds the register accumulator array (compile-time); only
224	//  `m_atoms` (<= MaxAtomsM) atoms are issued at runtime. `n_real <= N` marks
225	//  the valid column count for a ragged N-tile (pad operands are zero → inert).
226	//
227	//  Determinism: ascending-k, one CTA owns the tile end-to-end, no atomics.
228	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
229	template <int N, int MaxAtomsM, typename SrcA, typename SrcB, typename Out>
230	__device__ void tc_gemm_block_unpipelined(
231	        int mbase0, int m_atoms, int n_real, int k_steps,
232	        SrcA srcA, SrcB srcB, Out out,
233	        __nv_bfloat16* smemA, __nv_bfloat16* smemB) {
234	#if defined(__CUDA_ARCH__) && (__CUDA_ARCH__ >= 900)
235	    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
236	    const int nthreads = blockDim.x;            // 256
237	    const bool in_wg0 = (tid < 128);
238	    const int tid_wg = tid & 127;
239	
240	    wgs::WgmmaAccum<N> acc[MaxAtomsM];
241	
242	    #pragma unroll 1
243	    for (int a = 0; a < m_atoms; ++a) {
244	        const int mbase = mbase0 + a * wgs::kWgmmaAtomM;
245	        if (in_wg0) wgs::wgmma_fence();
246	        #pragma unroll 1
247	        for (int k = 0; k < k_steps; ++k) {
248	            stage_kmajor_tile<wgs::kWgmmaAtomM>(
249	                smemA, k * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK,
250	                [&] (int mn, int kk) { return srcA(mbase + mn, kk); },
251	                tid, nthreads);
252	            stage_kmajor_tile<N>(
253	                smemB, k * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK,
254	                [&] (int mn, int kk) { return srcB(mn, kk); },
255	                tid, nthreads);
256	            __syncthreads();   // staged tile visible to the whole CTA
257	            if (in_wg0) {
258	                wgs::SmemDesc dA = wgs::make_desc_A_kmajor<wgs::kWgmmaAtomM, wgs::kSwizzleNone>(smemA);
259	                wgs::SmemDesc dB = wgs::make_desc_B_kmajor<N, wgs::kSwizzleNone>(smemB);
260	                if (k == 0)
261	                    wgs::wgmma_m64nNk16_bf16<N, /*ScaleD=*/0, 0, 0>(acc[a], dA, dB);
262	                else
263	                    wgs::wgmma_m64nNk16_bf16<N, /*ScaleD=*/1, 0, 0>(acc[a], dA, dB);
264	                wgs::wgmma_commit_group();
265	                wgs::wgmma_wait_group<0>();
266	            }
267	            __syncthreads();   // MMA done reading smem before next stage overwrites
268	        }
269	        if (in_wg0) {
270	            #pragma unroll
271	            for (int i = 0; i < wgs::WgmmaAccum<N>::kRegs; ++i) {
272	                int row, col;
273	                wgs::wgmma_frag_decode(tid_wg, i, N, row, col);
274	                if (col < n_real) out(mbase + row, col, acc[a].c[i]);
275	            }
276	        }
277	        __syncthreads();
278	    }
279	#else
280	    (void)mbase0; (void)m_atoms; (void)n_real; (void)k_steps;
281	    (void)srcA; (void)srcB; (void)out; (void)smemA; (void)smemB;
282	#endif
283	}

285	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
286	//  THIN ORIENTATION WRAPPERS over tc_gemm_block_unpipelined — the THREE
287	//  accessor patterns the engine is silicon-validated on (fwd / dX / dW). The
288	//  driver calls THESE; it never re-derives the staging. N is the compile-time
289	//  wgmma atom width; the fwd/dX loops N-tiles internally. Weights convert
290	//  fp32→bf16 ON READ (deterministic; no bf16 weight buffer needed). Kin is
291	//  padded to a multiple of kWgmmaAtomK by the caller (49→64 for patch_proj).
292	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
293	
294	// (fwd) Y[M,Nout] = X[M,Kpad] @ W[Nout,Kin]ᵀ.  Tiles N over [0,Nout) in width-N
295	// atoms. M = m_atoms stacked atoms (kAtomsM for token tiles; fewer for the last
296	// ragged tile / patch tiles). Y bf16 row-major [M, Nout]. `Kreal` is the true
297	// contracted dim (<= Kpad); pad-K reads return 0 so they are inert.
298	template <int N>
299	__device__ __forceinline__ void vittc_gemm_fwd(
300	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ X, const float* __restrict__ W,
301	        __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ Yout, int Kreal, int Kpad, int Nout,
302	        int m_atoms, __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
303	    const int k_steps = Kpad / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
304	    for (int n0 = 0; n0 < Nout; n0 += N) {
305	        const int n_real = (Nout - n0) < N ? (Nout - n0) : N;
306	        auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
307	            return k < Kreal ? X[(int64_t)m * Kreal + k] : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
308	        auto srcB = [&] (int n, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
309	            int nn = n0 + n; return (nn < Nout && k < Kreal) ? __float2bfloat16(W[(int64_t)nn * Kreal + k]) : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
310	        auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) {
311	            Yout[(int64_t)m * Nout + n0 + n] = __float2bfloat16(v); };
312	        tc_gemm_block_unpipelined<N, /*MaxAtomsM=*/kAtomsM>(
313	            0, m_atoms, n_real, k_steps, srcA, srcB, out, sA, sB);
314	    }
315	}

319	// (K is never padded for these — only the in/out/ff GEMMs use it, all K∈{d,dff}
320	// already multiples of 16.)
321	template <int N>

323	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ X, const float* __restrict__ W,
324	        float* __restrict__ Yf32, int Kin, int Nout,
325	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
326	    const int k_steps = Kin / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
327	    for (int n0 = 0; n0 < Nout; n0 += N) {
328	        const int n_real = (Nout - n0) < N ? (Nout - n0) : N;
329	        auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 { return X[(int64_t)m * Kin + k]; };
330	        auto srcB = [&] (int n, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
331	            int nn = n0 + n; return nn < Nout ? __float2bfloat16(W[(int64_t)nn * Kin + k]) : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
332	        auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) { Yf32[(int64_t)m * Nout + n0 + n] = v; };
333	        tc_gemm_block_unpipelined<N, /*MaxAtomsM=*/kAtomsM>(
334	            0, kAtomsM, n_real, k_steps, srcA, srcB, out, sA, sB);

338	// (dX) dX[M,Kin] = dY[M,Nout] @ W[Nout,Kin].  N(wgmma)=Kin (tiled by width N),
339	// K=Nout. W staged transposed: srcB(n=kin,k=out)=W[out·Kin+kin] (fp32→bf16).
340	// Writes fp32 dX [M,Kin].
341	template <int N>
342	__device__ __forceinline__ void vittc_gemm_dx_f32(
343	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ dY, const float* __restrict__ W,
344	        float* __restrict__ dXf32, int Kin, int Nout,
345	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
346	    const int k_steps = Nout / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
347	    for (int n0 = 0; n0 < Kin; n0 += N) {
348	        const int n_real = (Kin - n0) < N ? (Kin - n0) : N;
349	        auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 { return dY[(int64_t)m * Nout + k]; };
350	        auto srcB = [&] (int n, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
351	            int nn = n0 + n; return nn < Kin ? __float2bfloat16(W[(int64_t)k * Kin + nn]) : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
352	        auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) { dXf32[(int64_t)m * Kin + n0 + n] = v; };
353	        tc_gemm_block_unpipelined<N, /*MaxAtomsM=*/kAtomsM>(
354	            0, kAtomsM, n_real, k_steps, srcA, srcB, out, sA, sB);
355	    }
356	}

358	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
359	//  Per-CTA TILE SCRATCH (HBM). One tile's forward intermediates the backward
360	//  reads, reused across the tiles a CTA grid-strides over. Sized for kTileM
361	//  rows. DEDICATED, NON-ALIASED buffers per fp32 intermediate (HBM is not
362	//  scarce; the aliasing bug class is avoided). qkv/ff0pre/attn/n1·n2 caches are
363	//  [kLayers]-indexed (the fwd runs ALL layers then bwd runs ALL layers, so each
364	//  layer's bwd-read state must persist per layer — the "layer-0 grads wrong"
365	//  bug). fnx/fni (final norm) + transient dh/x1/finalin/logits/work/work2/dsc
366	//  stay single.
367	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
368	constexpr int kNSampPerTile  = kTileM / vit::kSeq;
369	constexpr int kAttnPerTile   = kNSampPerTile * vit::kHeads * vit::kSeq * vit::kSeq;
370	constexpr int kLogitsPerTile = kNSampPerTile * vit::kVocab;
371	
372	struct VitTileScratch {
373	    __nv_bfloat16* qkv[vit::kLayers];     // [kTileM, 3d]  per layer
374	    __nv_bfloat16* ff0pre[vit::kLayers];  // [kTileM, dff] per layer
375	    float* attn[vit::kLayers];            // [kAttnPerTile] per layer
376	    float* n1x[vit::kLayers]; float* n1i[vit::kLayers];
377	    float* n2x[vit::kLayers]; float* n2i[vit::kLayers];
378	    float* dsc;             // [kAttnPerTile] attention dscores (transient, bwd-only)
379	    float* fnx; float* fni; // final-norm LN caches (single)
380	    float* dh;              // [kTileM, d]    running adjoint wrt block output
381	    float* x1;              // [kTileM, d]    n1 output (fp32, residual base for r2)
382	    float* finalin;         // [kTileM, d]    last-layer n2 output (fp32, head input)
383	    float* logits;          // [kLogitsPerTile] per-sample CLS-pos logits (fp32)
384	    float* work;            // [kTileM, dff]  GEMM output / general fp32 scratch
385	    float* work2;           // [kTileM, dff]  second fp32 scratch (bwd dx1/dqkv)
386	};

388	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tile_scratch_bf16_count() {
389	    return (int64_t)vit::kLayers * ((int64_t)kTileM * 3 * vit::kD + (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kDff);
390	}
391	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tile_scratch_f32_count() {
392	    return (int64_t)vit::kLayers * (
393	             (int64_t)kAttnPerTile
394	           + 2 * ((int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD + kTileM))
395	         + (int64_t)kAttnPerTile                          // dsc (single)
396	         + ((int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD + kTileM)           // fn xhat+inv (single)
397	         + (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD                      // dh
398	         + (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD                      // x1
399	         + (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD                      // finalin
400	         + (int64_t)kLogitsPerTile                        // logits
401	         + 2 * (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kDff;               // work + work2
402	}
403	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tile_scratch_total_f32() {
404	    return (vit_tile_scratch_bf16_count() + 1) / 2 + vit_tile_scratch_f32_count();
405	}

407	__device__ __forceinline__ VitTileScratch vit_tile_scratch_bind(float* slab) {
408	    VitTileScratch s;
409	    __nv_bfloat16* b = reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(slab);
410	    int64_t bo = 0;
411	    for (int li = 0; li < vit::kLayers; ++li) { s.qkv[li]    = b + bo; bo += (int64_t)kTileM * 3 * vit::kD; }
412	    for (int li = 0; li < vit::kLayers; ++li) { s.ff0pre[li] = b + bo; bo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kDff; }
413	    float* f = slab + (vit_tile_scratch_bf16_count() + 1) / 2;
414	    int64_t fo = 0;
415	    for (int li = 0; li < vit::kLayers; ++li) { s.attn[li] = f + fo; fo += kAttnPerTile; }
416	    for (int li = 0; li < vit::kLayers; ++li) { s.n1x[li] = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD; s.n1i[li] = f + fo; fo += kTileM; }
417	    for (int li = 0; li < vit::kLayers; ++li) { s.n2x[li] = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD; s.n2i[li] = f + fo; fo += kTileM; }
418	    s.dsc  = f + fo; fo += kAttnPerTile;
419	    s.fnx  = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD;
420	    s.fni  = f + fo; fo += kTileM;
421	    s.dh   = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD;
422	    s.x1   = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD;
423	    s.finalin = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD;
424	    s.logits  = f + fo; fo += kLogitsPerTile;
425	    s.work    = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kDff;
426	    s.work2   = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kDff;
427	    return s;

430	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
431	//  TILE-AWARE SCALAR ELEMENTWISE STAGES (fp32, CTA-cooperative over kTileM
432	//  rows). Mirror the scalar oracle's per-row math (model_stage_vit.cuh) but
433	//  operate on a whole tile of `nrows` rows at once over HBM [rows×width].
434	//  Reductions reuse vit_block_sum / vit_block_max (whole-block, looped per row).
435	//  `red` is a 256-float smem reduction slot.
436	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
437	
438	// LayerNorm fwd over the last dim d, for `nrows` rows. y/xhat fp32 HBM [rows×d];
439	// inv fp32 HBM [rows]. gamma/beta fp32 [d]. Caches xhat+inv for the bwd.
440	__device__ __forceinline__ void vittc_ln_fwd_tile(
441	        const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ gamma,
442	        const float* __restrict__ beta, int nrows,
443	        float* __restrict__ y, float* __restrict__ xhat, float* __restrict__ inv,
444	        float* red) {
445	    for (int s = 0; s < nrows; ++s) {
446	        const float* xr = x + (int64_t)s * vit::kD;
447	        float sum = 0.0f;
448	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < vit::kD; j += blockDim.x) sum += xr[j];
449	        float mean = vit_block_sum(sum, red) / (float)vit::kD;
450	        float vs = 0.0f;
451	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < vit::kD; j += blockDim.x) { float c = xr[j] - mean; vs += c * c; }
452	        float var = vit_block_sum(vs, red) / (float)vit::kD;
453	        float iv = rsqrtf(var + vit::kLnEps);
454	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) inv[s] = iv;
455	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < vit::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
456	            float xh = (xr[j] - mean) * iv;
457	            xhat[(int64_t)s * vit::kD + j] = xh;
458	            y[(int64_t)s * vit::kD + j] = xh * gamma[j] + beta[j];
459	        }
460	        __syncthreads();
461	    }
462	}

464	// LayerNorm bwd for `nrows` rows: dy [rows×d] fp32, cached xhat/inv → dx [rows×d]
465	// fp32; ACCUMULATES dgamma/dbeta (summed over the tile's rows) into a per-CTA
466	// LN-vec partial slot gw/gb [d] (plain += : single owner thread per feature j
467	// across rows, deterministic — same rule as the scalar vit_layernorm_bwd).
468	__device__ __forceinline__ void vittc_ln_bwd_tile(
469	        const float* __restrict__ dy, const float* __restrict__ xhat,
470	        const float* __restrict__ inv, const float* __restrict__ gamma, int nrows,
471	        float* __restrict__ dx, float* __restrict__ gw, float* __restrict__ gb,
472	        float* red) {
473	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < vit::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
474	        float dgw = 0.0f, dgb = 0.0f;
475	        for (int s = 0; s < nrows; ++s) {
476	            float d = dy[(int64_t)s * vit::kD + j];
477	            dgb += d; dgw += d * xhat[(int64_t)s * vit::kD + j];
478	        }
479	        gw[j] += dgw; gb[j] += dgb;
480	    }
481	    for (int s = 0; s < nrows; ++s) {
482	        const float* dyr = dy + (int64_t)s * vit::kD;
483	        const float* xhr = xhat + (int64_t)s * vit::kD;
484	        float sda = 0.0f, sdax = 0.0f;
485	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < vit::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
486	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * gamma[j]; sda += dxhat; sdax += dxhat * xhr[j];
487	        }
488	        sda = vit_block_sum(sda, red);
489	        sdax = vit_block_sum(sdax, red);
490	        float iv = inv[s];
491	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < vit::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
492	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * gamma[j];
493	            dx[(int64_t)s * vit::kD + j] = iv * (dxhat - (sda + xhr[j] * sdax) / (float)vit::kD);
494	        }
495	        __syncthreads();
496	    }

512	        const int rem = r % (vit::kHeads * vit::kSeq);
513	        const int hh = rem / vit::kSeq, qi = rem % vit::kSeq;

516	        const __nv_bfloat16* qrow = qkv + (int64_t)(rbase + qi) * 3 * vit::kD + qoff;

518	        #pragma unroll
519	        for (int kj = 0; kj < vit::kSeq; ++kj) {   // FULL: every key position
520	            const __nv_bfloat16* krow = qkv + (int64_t)(rbase + kj) * 3 * vit::kD + vit::kD + qoff;

534	        #pragma unroll

539	                float vv = __bfloat162float(qkv[(int64_t)(rbase + kj) * 3 * vit::kD + 2 * vit::kD + qoff + t]);

294	def _eager_decoder(device="cuda", seed=0):
295	    """The exact race decoder (== tests/hw/test_megakernel_vs_eager's builder),
296	    fp32 params. Autocast supplies the bf16 matmul boundary."""
297	    import torch.nn as nn
298	    from tests.hw.decoder_oracle import VOCAB, D_MODEL, N_HEADS, N_LAYERS, SEQ
299	
300	    class DecoderBlock(nn.Module):
301	        def __init__(self, d, h, seq_len=4):
302	            super().__init__()
303	            self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(d, h, dropout=0., batch_first=True)
304	            self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d); self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
305	            self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, 4 * d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(4 * d, d))
306	            self.register_buffer('causal_mask',
307	                                 torch.triu(torch.ones(seq_len, seq_len, dtype=torch.bool), 1))
308	
309	        def forward(self, x):
310	            a, _ = self.attn(x, x, x, attn_mask=self.causal_mask)
311	            x = self.n1(x + a); return self.n2(x + self.ff(x))
312	
313	    class Transformer(nn.Module):
314	        def __init__(self, nl=2, d=128, h=4, ntok=99, seq=4):
315	            super().__init__()
316	            self.tok = nn.Embedding(ntok, d); self.pos = nn.Embedding(seq, d)
317	            self.layers = nn.ModuleList([DecoderBlock(d, h, seq_len=seq) for _ in range(nl)])
318	            self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d); self.out = nn.Linear(d, ntok)
319	            self.register_buffer('pos_ids', torch.arange(seq).unsqueeze(0))
320	
321	        def forward(self, x):
322	            h = self.tok(x) + self.pos(self.pos_ids)
323	            for l in self.layers:
324	                h = l(h)
325	            return self.out(self.norm(h)[:, -1, :])
326	
327	    torch.manual_seed(seed)
328	    return Transformer(N_LAYERS, D_MODEL, N_HEADS, VOCAB, SEQ).to(device)

336	    """One fwd+bwd of the eager decoder under autocast(bf16) — the bf16-matmul/
337	    fp32-accumulate oracle the TC kernel emulates. Returns (loss float, grads
338	    dict name→tensor)."""

341	    with torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16):

349	def _bf16_faithful_oracle(named, tokens, targets):
350	    """The R2.3 NAMED reference (DESIGN §5.2): the decoder fwd+bwd computed in
351	    fp64 but with EVERY value the TC kernel STORES rounded to bf16 at the SAME
352	    points (DecActs X_in/X_ctx/X_x1/X_gact, qkv, ff0pre, X_hn, every dY_*, dh0;
353	    weights bf16-on-read). Math is fp64; bf16 ONLY at the kernel's storage points.
354	
355	    Unlike autocast-bf16 (which keeps adjoints fp32 through the backward and casts
356	    only at matmul inputs), this rounds at the kernel's exact storage boundary, so
357	    a real kernel bug shows rel~1 while the intended bf16-storage shows ~bf16-floor.
358	    This is the faithful instrument that separates a bug from bf16 noise. Runs on
359	    CPU (fp64, tiny) so it never competes with the kernel for GPU memory.
360	    Transcribed from tests/hw/decoder_oracle.py with the storage rounds inserted."""
361	    import math
362	    from tests.hw.decoder_oracle import (
363	        VOCAB, D_MODEL, N_HEADS, N_LAYERS, SEQ, D_FF, D_HEAD, ATTN_SCALE,
364	        gelu, gelu_grad, layernorm_forward, layernorm_backward,
365	        softmax_lastdim, softmax_backward, _causal_mask, DecoderWeights)
366	    B16 = torch.bfloat16
367	
368	    def bf(x):
369	        return x.to(B16).to(torch.float64)
370	
371	    W = DecoderWeights.from_named({k: v.double() for k, v in named.items()})
372	    Bn, S = tokens.shape
373	    dev = tokens.device
374	    add_mask = _causal_mask(S, dev, torch.float64)
375	    pos_ids = torch.arange(S, device=dev)
376	    h = bf(bf(W.tok)[tokens] + bf(W.pos)[pos_ids].unsqueeze(0))   # X_in[0] bf16
377	    caches = []
378	    for li in range(N_LAYERS):
379	        L = W.layers[li]
380	        x_in = h
381	        qkv = bf(x_in @ bf(L["in_w"]).t() + L["in_b"].double())   # qkv bf16
382	        q, k, v = qkv.split(D_MODEL, dim=-1)
383	        def sh(t): return t.reshape(Bn, S, N_HEADS, D_HEAD).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
384	        qh, kh, vh = sh(q), sh(k), sh(v)
385	        scores = (qh @ kh.transpose(-2, -1)) * ATTN_SCALE + add_mask   # fp64 attn
386	        attn = softmax_lastdim(scores)
387	        ctx = (attn @ vh).permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(Bn, S, D_MODEL)
388	        ctx_b = bf(ctx)                                            # X_ctx bf16
389	        a = (ctx_b @ bf(L["out_w"]).t() + L["out_b"].double())     # fp32 work (NOT stored bf16)
390	        r1 = x_in + a
391	        x1, ln1 = layernorm_forward(r1, L["n1_w"].double(), L["n1_b"].double())
392	        x1_b = bf(x1)                                              # X_x1 bf16
393	        ff0 = x1_b @ bf(L["ff0_w"]).t() + L["ff0_b"].double()
394	        ff0_b = bf(ff0)                                            # ff0pre bf16
395	        g = bf(gelu(ff0))                                         # X_gact bf16
396	        ff2 = g @ bf(L["ff2_w"]).t() + L["ff2_b"].double()
397	        r2 = x1 + ff2
398	        h2, ln2 = layernorm_forward(r2, L["n2_w"].double(), L["n2_b"].double())
399	        h = bf(h2) if li + 1 < N_LAYERS else h2                    # X_in[li+1] bf16 / finalin fp32
400	        caches.append(dict(x_in=x_in, attn=attn, vh=vh, qh=qh, kh=kh, ctx=ctx_b,
401	                           x1=x1, x1_b=x1_b, ln1=ln1, ff0_b=ff0_b, g=g, ln2=ln2))
402	    h_last = h[:, -1, :]
403	    hn, nc = layernorm_forward(h_last, W.norm_w.double(), W.norm_b.double())
404	    hn_b = bf(hn)                                                 # X_hn bf16
405	    logits = hn_b @ W.out_w.double().t() + W.out_b.double()
406	    mx = logits.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
407	    logz = mx.squeeze(-1) + torch.log(torch.exp(logits - mx).sum(dim=-1))
408	    loss = (logz - logits.gather(1, targets.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)).mean()
409	    grads = {}
410	    sm = softmax_lastdim(logits); oh = torch.zeros_like(sm)
411	    oh.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0)
412	    dlogits = bf((sm - oh) / Bn)                                  # dY_logits bf16
413	    grads["out.weight"] = dlogits.t() @ hn_b
414	    grads["out.bias"] = dlogits.sum(0)
415	    dhn = dlogits @ W.out_w.double()
416	    dh_last, dnw, dnb = layernorm_backward(dhn, nc)
417	    grads["norm.weight"] = dnw; grads["norm.bias"] = dnb
418	    dh = torch.zeros(Bn, S, D_MODEL, device=dev, dtype=torch.float64); dh[:, -1, :] = dh_last
419	    for li in reversed(range(N_LAYERS)):
420	        L = W.layers[li]; lc = caches[li]
421	        dr2, d2w, d2b = layernorm_backward(dh, lc["ln2"])
422	        grads[f"layers.{li}.n2.weight"] = d2w; grads[f"layers.{li}.n2.bias"] = d2b
423	        dff2 = bf(dr2)                                            # dY_ff2 bf16
424	        dx1 = dr2.clone()
425	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.2.weight"] = dff2.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).t() @ lc["g"].reshape(-1, D_FF)
426	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.2.bias"] = dff2.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).sum(0)
427	        dg = dff2 @ bf(L["ff2_w"])
428	        dff0 = bf(dg * gelu_grad(lc["ff0_b"]))                    # dY_ff0 bf16; gelu' reads ff0pre(bf16)
429	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.0.weight"] = dff0.reshape(-1, D_FF).t() @ lc["x1_b"].reshape(-1, D_MODEL)
430	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.0.bias"] = dff0.reshape(-1, D_FF).sum(0)
431	        dx1 = dx1 + dff0 @ bf(L["ff0_w"])
432	        dr1, d1w, d1b = layernorm_backward(dx1, lc["ln1"])
